What's your return and refund policy?
Our policies differ for rentals and purchases:
Rental returns: Items must be sent back on the last rental day via tracked next‑day delivery, from within the UK only, and in the same condition you received them (no new damage, stains, or alterations). Normal post‑rental cleaning is the lender’s job.
Late returns: If you return after the final rental day, lenders can charge late fees.
Poor condition on arrival: If your rental arrives damaged, misrepresented, or not as described, take photos the same day, message the lender immediately, and return within 24 hours. Then submit a refund request in the app.
Late delivery: If the item doesn’t arrive on the first rental day, you’re generally entitled to a full refund if you report it and return the item within 24 hours of delivery. If you keep it longer, you may only get a partial refund or no refund if you use it for the full rental period.
Change of mind / standard refunds: You can request a refund from the Rental page in the app, but you’ll only qualify if the item is returned within 24 hours of receiving it. If you keep it for the full rental period, you’re not eligible for a refund.
Fit issues: Refunds for items that don’t fit depend on the lender’s policy. If allowed, they’re issued as By Rotation app credit only (no cash out, no expiry). Rental days can be credited; delivery and cleaning fees are non‑refundable.
How refunds work: Open the rental in the app → tap Request Refund → enter the amount. The lender must approve. Platform service fees are non‑refundable; only the rental cost can be refunded. Approved refunds usually process within about 8 working days.
If the lender doesn’t respond: When you’ve requested a refund and the lender hasn’t replied within 72 hours, you can email help@byrotation.com with your rental details and photos so our team can step in.
Lenders issuing refunds: Lenders can also tap Issue a Refund on the rental, choose an amount (up to the rental cost), and the amount will adjust their payout; if done after completion, it may show as a negative balance until their next payout.
Cleaning / damage fees: If an item is returned with stains or damage that needs more than standard cleaning, lenders can charge cleaning or repair fees, ideally backed by receipts.
Final invoices & sales: Any invoice that both parties agreed to and has been processed is final and non‑refundable. Likewise, all resale purchases are final—no refunds once a sale goes through.
